title: As Google plans to build a $15B AI data center hub in India's Visakhapatnam, locals and rights groups are raising concerns over "extremely high" water stress (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: As Google plans to build a $15B AI data center hub in India's Visakhapatnam, locals and rights groups are raising concerns over “extremely high” water stress — Developing-world nations are offering billions of dollars in incentives for U.S. data centers, but locals say the cost is too high
